annotations.title: Check whether a reply was accepted

description:
Look up a manual reply by the idempotency key it was sent with, to learn whether the API accepted it for sending before you send it again. accepted means it is queued to go out, not that it was delivered; not_found means no accepted send exists under that key.

Luca operation: GET /api/conversations/{id}/send-status
Required scopes: conversations:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_conversations_send_status
title: Check whether a reply was accepted
